title: Which One Is Sounding? Binaural Sounding Instance Disambiguation for Audio-Visual Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing audio-visual segmentation methods mainly predict sound-related regions or category masks and often fail to identify the sounding instance when multiple same-class candidates coexist. Recent audio-visual instance segmentation methods address instance-level prediction but rely largely on motion and cross-frame association, which may become unreliable under sparse observations or inconspicuous motion. To this end, we introduce binaural audio, whose interaural differences encode source-direction information, to provide spatial constraints for distinguishing the sounding instance among same-class visual candidates. We propose Binaural Sounding Instance Disambiguation for Audio-Visual Segmentation (BiSID-AVS), which progressively refines category-level candidate responses into a mask of the true sounding instance. translated_title: 哪一个在发声？面向视听分割的双耳发声实例消歧
translated_abstract: 现有的视听分割方法主要预测与声音相关的区域或类别掩码，当多个同类候选实例共存时，往往无法识别真正发声的实例。近期的视听实例分割方法虽然解决了实例级预测问题，但在很大程度上依赖运动信息和跨帧关联，在观测稀疏或运动不显著的情况下可能变得不可靠。为此，我们引入双耳音频，其耳间差异编码了声源方向信息，可为在同类视觉候选中区分发声实例提供空间约束。我们提出了面向视听分割的双耳发声实例消歧方法，该方法逐步将类别级候选响应细化为真正发声实例的掩码。BiSID-AVS 首先通过音频提示定位类别一致的候选区域，然后将双耳线索投影到……
tldr: 该论文提出BiSID-AVS方法，利用双耳音频中耳间差异所编码的声源方向信息作为空间约束，在多个同类视觉候选中准确区分并分割出真正发声的实例，克服了传统方法依赖运动和跨帧关联的局限。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes BiSID-AVS, which leverages interaural differences in binaural audio that encode source-direction information as spatial constraints to accurately disambiguate and segment the true sounding instance among multiple same-class visual candidates, overcoming the limitations of relying on motion and cross-frame association.
